Method of Attack: Malware downloader that infects systems to inject cryptocurrency miner
Hollows legitimate OS process explorer.exe to inject malicious code
Spins off a second explorer.exe process to download and run a cryptocurrency miner masquerading as wuauclt.exe
Uses advanced cross-process injection techniques, persistence mechanisms, and evasion methods
Generates suspicious network traffic contacting C&C servers on decentralized Namecoin network
Attack Vector: Infection via trojans detected and blocked by Windows Defender AV
Malicious code injection into legitimate OS processes
Indicators of Compromise: Malicious instances detected by Windows Defender AV under machine learning names Fuery, Fuerboos, Cloxer, Azden, later as Dofoil or Coinminer
Malicious binary wuauclt.exe running from wrong disk location
Command and control servers located on decentralized Namecoin .bit domains
